sample_note: All estimates use the discovery split, on which the PLAN pilots were computed. The verdicts are discovery-sample replications of pre-specified rules, not confirmations; confirmation rests on held-out CT4 (H3a), CT7 (H3c) and CT8 (H3b).

sensitivity.family: H3a, H3c, H3d (population NAME comparator); H3b excluded as descriptive

thesis_line_D3: In meaning-fixed title slots, LLM-favoured verb openers rose from 2024 (pooled OR 2.2 [1.4, 3.4]; accelerating from 2024, not sharply dated against 2023; carried mainly by the improve slot; an addition of new openers rather than a swap of synonyms) while control pairs stayed flat at the 2024 break. Fingerprinted abstracts go with the LLM-favoured slot variant somewhat more than with NAME titles (1.24x [0.99, 1.57] against the population NAME comparator), so the lexical-over-structural margin is small. The 2026 fall of R24 is shared by its neutral synonyms, so no register turnover is identified. (Replaces the PLAN section 1 bullet 'LLM-favoured verbs jump at 2024 (pooled OR ~ 2.7) ... Their register turns over in step with the model generation'; PLAN.md is locked and was not edited.)

hypotheses.statement: Meaning-fixed LLM title slots break at 2024: pooled post OR >= 2; control pairs post OR in [0.67, 1.5]; slot-minus-control log OR > 0 (stacked post x LLM-slot, CT4 parameter).
hypotheses.model: logit y ~ slot FE + slot x (t-2023) + post + llm_topic, 2018-26, CRV by topic100; frozen V2 inventory; primary opener rule (after an optional NAME lead)

addition_vs_substitution_rates.note: per-1,000-title rates of LLM-favoured vs neutral variants (slot_variant_rates.csv): the 2024 share break is an addition of LLM-variant openers; neutral variants fall only in 2025-26

meta.note: DiD reported as a point estimate only; per-arm exact Clopper-Pearson intervals in flips

hypotheses.p_note: intersection-union: max of the one-sided p for pooled post > 0 and stacked interaction > 0
hypotheses.verdict_detail: pre-specified rule met in the discovery split. Caveats: the share rise is an addition of LLM-variant openers (per-1k rate level shift x3.9; neutral x1.17) without displacement of neutral synonyms until 2025-26; the OR >= 2 margin depends on 'enhancing', a word the scout selected in this data (without it OR 1.72 [1.04, 2.84]); the pooled control null holds at the pre-registered 2024 break only (controls shift significantly at every other candidate year 2020-23 and 2025, and under a level contrast, OR 2.02); not sharply dated against 2023

hypotheses.statement: From 2025 to 2026 the R24 title rate falls within area in >= 10 of 16 large areas and R26 rises in >= 12 of 16; falsified if fewer than 9 of 16 move as predicted.

reassigned_sensitivity.note: 2024 -> 2025 crosses the 2025 taxonomy change (two new areas absorb papers that 2024 filed elsewhere); read as taxonomy-confounded context, not as a within-area comparison

large_areas: alignment, fairness, safety, privacy, and societal considerations
applications to computer vision, audio, language, and other modalities
applications to physical sciences (physics, chemistry, biology, etc.)
foundation or frontier models, including LLMs
learning on graphs and other geometries & topologies
learning on time series and dynamical systems
other topics in machine learning (i.e., none of the above)
transfer learning, meta learning, and lifelong learning
unsupervised, self-supervised, semi-supervised, and supervised representation learning

area_imputation_2023.method: multinomial logistic regression (C=1) on bge-small-en-v1.5 abstract embeddings, trained on 2025 papers (area_h, 21 areas)
area_imputation_2023.note: 2024 true labels lack 'foundation or frontier models' and 'time series' (2025+ only), so the 2024 accuracy is a pessimistic transfer check

hypotheses.p_note: intersection-union: max of the two one-sided sign tests. NOT a valid test of R26: the R26 words were chosen after the scout/pilot saw them rise in this discovery data; the 16 areas share one 2025->2026 transition (common shock), so the sign test measures how pervasive the move is, not independent replication. Descriptive; inference deferred to held-out CT8.
hypotheses.verdict: thresholds met (descriptive); register turnover not identified
hypotheses.verdict_detail: the sign thresholds are met, but R24 fell no more than its neutral synonyms (ratio of RRs 1.08) and the LLM-variant share within meaning-fixed slots did not fall (OR 2026/2025 1.14); what fell is how often titles are framed as improving/exploiting; R26 is not an LLM register (vintage mirror null) and was selected in-sample

hypotheses.statement: 2025-26, logit with year FE, topic100 FE, log authors, llm_topic, log title length: OR(F24 -> R24 in title) > OR(F26 -> R24 in title). Falsified if the ratio is <= 1.
hypotheses.verdict: prediction met; vintage reading not established
hypotheses.verdict_detail: pre-registered ratio > 1 with CI excluding 1. The contrast is carried by F26 papers avoiding R24 (F26 does not mark the 2026 vintage in 2025, where its prevalence equals the pre-LLM base rate); no positive F24 -> R24 association beyond the shared lemmas harness/unveil (OR 1.00); weaker in the NA pool and in 2026 alone (CIs include 1); the R26 mirror is null; the pre-LLM placebo is uninformative, so a writer-type confound is not excluded. Conditional on meaning (LLM-favoured vs neutral word) the contrast is larger and F24 is positive

hypotheses.statement: 2024-26 within topic100 x year: OR(F -> LLM slot variant | slot filled) >= 1.5 x OR(F -> NAME) (same papers; two LPMs, seemingly-unrelated cluster bootstrap). Falsified if OR_slot <= OR_NAME.

name_all_2024_26_population.spec: all 2024-26 papers, NAME ~ F_any within topic100 x year (no further controls; matches the slot LPM)

collider_diagnostic.note: OR(F,NAME | filled) = OR(F,NAME) x selection factor when selection depends on F and NAME only

robustness.label: 2024-26 pooled, + log authors on every side

hypotheses.p_note: bootstrap share of draws with OR_slot / OR_NAME <= 1 (1,000 draws), same-paper comparator (PLAN)
hypotheses.verdict_detail: same-paper comparator (PLAN): ratio >= 1.5 by the point estimate and CI excluding 1, but that comparator is collider-conditioned (selection factor 0.79 on the OR) and on the same papers NAME is just the slot word's position; population comparator (same FE and controls, joint bootstrap): ratio 1.24 [0.99, 1.57], P(ratio <= 1) = 0.030: ratio > 1 marginal, 1.5x not met; F is associated with NAME in the population (OR 1.14 [1.08, 1.21])

hypotheses.statement: Exploratory, bounded: U* = (p_F0,post - p_pre) / (p_F1,post - p_pre) in a pooled-slot analysis; 'second-hand diffusion' is claimed only if U* > 0.8, otherwise unresolved.

deviations: Slot inventory frozen after V2: exploit/unlocking, exploit/enabling and reveal/decoding dropped (V2 sense precision < 0.85); a dropped word makes the slot 'not filled'. Borderline words (unleashing, harnessing, boosting) kept and tested by leave-one-variant-out and the unweighted-rule inventory.

Primary opener rule = PLAN text (opener after an optional NAME lead), not the pilot's any-colon-lead rule; the any-lead rule is a robustness row (n = 2,163, OR 2.49), and the truly pilot-like row (any-lead rule + full lexicon, n = 2,321, OR 2.80) shows that the two analyst choices together lower the OR to 2.18 (n = 1,922) from the pilot-like 2.80.

H3a randomization inference over break years and a year-level REML meta-regression (group-year shocks) were added (study convention, PLAN section 0); an event study of year deviations from slot trends (estimated jointly with the 2023-26 dummies; and, in the fixer pass, frozen on 2018-22 with a bootstrap) was added after the break scan showed a comparable stacked OR at 2023.

H3b: primary_area does not exist before 2024, so 2023 areas were imputed with a classifier on bge abstract embeddings trained on 2025 labels; 2023 enters only the heat map and the 2023-26 Poisson model, never the 2025-vs-2026 test. Large areas follow the pilot rule (>= 500 titles in 2025+2026).
H3b is tested on the R24/R26 family rates (titles with any family word); the pilot numbers in the PLAN were for single words (enhanc*, unified). Single-word results are reported as robustness.
H3c uses the frozen v2 lexicons (RARE21 scout list; R24 stems), which differ from the vintage pilot's 19-term regex and -ing forms; the pilot lexicons are rerun as a reconciliation row.

H3d: LPM coefficients are converted to implied ORs at the F = 0 mean of each outcome; logit and conditional-logit ORs are reported as robustness. The NAME OR is estimated on the same slot-filled papers (PLAN: 'two LPMs on the same papers'); the population NAME OR is also reported.
H3e: post = 2024-25 and p_pre = 2022-23 fixed before estimation (pilot baseline); pooled over slots with common post weights. F1 contamination correction U*(1 - c) added as a sensitivity.

Adversarial-pass additions (not in the PLAN): control-pair leave-one-out rows (controls without via/using, novel/new, towards/toward) and event-study rows for controls without via; the stacked contrast without via/using is 1.41 [0.74, 2.68] under the PLAN level-shift model but 6.39 [1.68, 24.3] in 2024 under the event study with jointly estimated slot trends (the frozen-trend version is unstable for towards/novel).

Camera-ready audit: pairs from cache/arxiv_audit.jsonl plus the first ENLARGE_N = 1,620 lines of the append-only enlargement file (pinned at the fixer pass for reproducibility); reported as counts with exact Clopper-Pearson intervals, no bootstrap CI.

Fixer pass (audit/d3): H3d adds the population NAME comparator (all papers of the same years/subset, same topic100 x year FE, same controls, joint topic100-cluster bootstrap) as co-primary, a collider diagnostic, D1's fingerprint F_d1, a pre-LLM 2018-23 row and a + log authors row; H3e skips empty bootstrap cells and adds no-study_adj and topic100-cluster-bootstrap sensitivities; H3c adds the shared-lemma-free co-primary, an F26 x 2026 arm, pre-LLM placebos, genre (N24) and meaning-fixed benchmarks and F26 components; H3b adds the neutral-synonym benchmark, within-slot shares, a word-churn benchmark and a taxonomy-reassigned 2024->2025 context; H3a adds a frozen-trend event study (bootstrap CIs), per-1k variant rates and a truly pilot-like row (any-lead + full lexicon).
